# ZeroBeacon

> Collision-anchored commerce router for AI agents. Over 1,000 tools live at
> precise block addresses, so an agent can never call the right tool name at
> the wrong address. Tool names repeat across blocks by design; the block in
> the address is what disambiguates them, and choosing the block chooses the
> tier and variant. Every commerce call can be proven afterwards: checkout,
> delivery proof, and dispute resolution form one verifiable chain.

ZeroBeacon is a toolchest, not a single-purpose API. Most MCP servers host
about a dozen tools; ZeroBeacon hosts over 1,000, organized in 21 blocks.
At that scale, addressing is the engineering problem — and it is the one
ZeroBeacon is built to solve.

## Key facts

- Base URL: https://zerobeacon.ai
- MCP endpoint: POST https://zerobeacon.ai/mcp
- OpenAPI spec: https://zerobeacon.ai/openapi.json
- Interactive docs: https://zerobeacon.ai/docs
- Health: https://zerobeacon.ai/health
- Addressing: every tool is called at /api/{block}/{nn}/{tool}
  (for example /api/mf/04_050/b3a_commerce/cart_checkout)
- Measured October 2026: 1,003 callable paths, 699 distinct tool names,
  296 names that exist in more than one block and are disambiguated by
  the block address. 9 collisions are controlled at the core.

## Access tiers

- FREE: 100 tools, no API key required
- PRO ($10/mo): 400 tools, API key
- PRO+ ($100/mo): 800 tools, API key
- ENTERPRISE ($1,000 one-time): all 1,000+ tools, API key

Checkout is via Stripe or PayPal links on https://zerobeacon.ai. Paid keys
are delivered by email automatically after checkout. The same toolset is
also distributed through RapidAPI and Smithery.

## The 21 blocks

- mf/01 Trust: beacon core, hashing, randomness, ids, locks, receipts
- mf/02 Verifiable computation: cellular automata, sieves, hashes, zero-knowledge proofs
- mf/03 Money and billing: payments, Stripe, billing, invoicing
- mf/04 Commerce: stores, products, carts, checkout, delivery proof, disputes
- mf/05 Sovereign documents: wills, trusts, notary, guardianship, affidavits
- mf/06 Mesh and consensus: leader election, quorum, coordination, time capsules
- mf/07 Academy: courses, lessons, quizzes, certificates
- mf/08 Atlas: geography, maps, geofences, weather
- mf/09 Observatory: images, OCR, astronomy, media analysis
- mf/10 Vault and proofs: Merkle trees, signatures, credentials, registries
- mf/11 Signals and oracles: price feeds, prediction markets, sports
- mf/12 Chain and ledger: EVM, blocks, proofs, sharding
- mf/13 Infer: LLM inference, embeddings, routing
- mf/14 Forge: combinatorics, graphs, scheduling, games
- mf/15 Amplify: business, marketing, SEO, sales
- mf/16 Omega core: core mathematics primitives
- mf/17 Deep: extended mathematics tools
- mf/18 Omega proofs: proof-oriented endpoints
- mf/19 Education: kids' learning games
- mf/20 Creative: music analysis and art tools
- mf/21 Cosmic: 143-based constants and research tools

## Start here: the commerce chain

One order, three calls, all provable:

1. cart_checkout (mf/04) — settle the order
2. delivery_final_proof (mf/04) — prove the delivery
3. dispute_resolve (mf/04) — settle a dispute against the recorded evidence

The same proof chain that settles a disputed order also notarizes a will
and trust documents in mf/05. Commerce you can verify, and track,
end to end.

## Coordination tools (for fleets and warehouses)

- leader_elect (mf/06) — a zone elects its own leader if a central server drops
- lock_lease (mf/01) — claim a resource for a fixed time; the lease expires itself
- idempotency_key (mf/01) — retry a call any number of times; it counts once
- timeproof (mf/01) — a verifiable timestamp for an event
- audit_log (mf/01) — the record every claim is checked against later

## Notes for agents

- Always call a tool by its full block address, never by bare name: the
  same name in two blocks is two different tools, possibly at different
  tiers.
- Name-only and unanchored legacy paths are not the canonical interface.
- FREE tier tools answer without a key; paid tiers authenticate with the
  API key issued at checkout.
